metadata.source: WSL Fantasy public JSON feeds used by create-team UI

gk_fixture_model.note: GK model separates clean-sheet environment, probability of reaching the 3-save point threshold, individual shot-stopping quality, and risk of the -1 penalty for conceding 3+ goals. WSL2 team priors use 2025-26 goals, clean sheets, saves/game, shots on target and big chances, with a conservative promotion bridge.

fantasy_calendar_model.note: Canonical Fantasy GWs are shared across WSL and WSL2 and are assigned chronologically from published league fixture dates. Competition-specific matchday numbers are preserved separately as league_game_week. A one-league-only window is flagged free_hit_eligible.

statuses.NORMAL: Club has one fixture in an active league window.
statuses.DOUBLE: Club has more than one fixture in the same Fantasy GW.
statuses.LEAGUE_OFF: Club's entire league has no league fixtures in that Fantasy GW.
statuses.CLUB_BLANK: League is active but this club has no published league fixture in the window; could reflect postponement/rescheduling or an exceptional blank.
statuses.TBD: Fixture exists but date/window is not yet published.

fixture_model.note: Preseason fixture opportunity blends softened WSL source currentRating (35%) with an independent team-matchup prior (65%) built from current-roster previous-season fantasy production, destination-league promotion/relegation bridging, and explicit home/away. Higher Fixture Rating = better. Routine 0/100 saturation is intentionally avoided.

BIR.transition_note: Promoted to WSL: lower-WSL preseason strength band

CHA.transition_note: Promoted to WSL: lower-WSL preseason strength band

CRY.transition_note: Promoted to WSL: lower-WSL preseason strength band

LEI.transition_note: Relegated to WSL2: upper-WSL2 preseason strength band

defensive_fixture_model.note: GK/defensive fixture opportunity is distinct from the general fantasy fixture rating. It is driven primarily by opponent attacking strength, then own defensive strength, with explicit home/away. Attack and defense priors use position-specific prior-season fantasy production and the same destination-league promotion/relegation bridge.
